html:
Question 13
?

Find the domain of the function f(x,y)=arccos⁡(x+y).

a
The domain is the entire xy-plane
b
{(x,y)∈R2:0≤x+y≤π,y≥0}
c
{(x,y)∈R2:−1≤x+y≤1,y≠0}
d
{(x,y)∈R2:−π≤x+y≤π,y>0}
e
{(x,y)∈R2:−1≤x+y≤1,y≥0}
Submit
